svg.text: Three cuts of the same robot. A keeps the speech tail, B is cleanest at 16 px, C adds robot ears.

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, Helvetica Neue, sans-serif

svg.text: The bot inside the bubble: white head, cobalt shell, cloud on the chest. Same face geometry as the icon, so character and mark never drift apart.
• Head = the icon bubble, same 240 : 210 ratio
• Eyes are the icon's pill holes; navy fill, one glint
• Antenna tip = sky glow, the only animated accent
• Chest cloud = DEX Cloud, small enough to drop
• White mittens + blush: reads friendly at 24 px
Open question: does DEX keep the speech tail, or only the icon?
Minimum mark size 16 px · clear space = one eye height
